europe_now.title: US Waives Russia Sanctions Amid Ukraine Strain
europe_now.summary: Washington has issued waivers for several Russian sanctions as tensions intensify following a deterioration in relations with Kyiv. European officials have criticized restrictions on support, prompting renewed efforts to bolster regional backing.

sources.headline: Trump waives new Russia sanctions as Ukraine ties slump

europe_now.title: Nationwide Protests and Unrest Spread Across France
europe_now.summary: France is bracing for extensive demonstrations as trade unions, students, and Yellow Vests coordinate nationwide actions and attempt to establish roadblocks. Law enforcement has responded with crackdowns as social mobilization intensifies significantly.

sources.headline: Students, trade unions and Yellow Vests set to protest across France

top_stories.title: European Union Leaders Debate Migration and Policy at Summit
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders gathered in Brussels for discussions addressing regional budgets, migration regulations, and broader policy priorities. Member states engaged in contentious debates regarding national migration regularization plans without reaching immediate consensus on major decisions.

sources.headline: EU leaders clash over migration, Ukraine and budget in Brussels — but delay big decisions
